title: SliceNormalizedScalarComparisons
statement: Let C be an arbitrary site, R a commutative ring sheaf, V an object, with module sheafification and locally-bijective compatibility on C and C/V in the stated universes. Use the actual extension, restriction, scalar extension and normalization predicates of [def-sf-slice-tensor-generator-interfaces]. There exist natural isomorphisms k_A: j_R! Res N ≅ Res j_A! N for all R-algebras A, normalized as the identity on each original extension summand, uniquely among isomorphisms with this normalization; and coefficient-linear natural isomorphisms l_A: extend_A j_R! M ≅ j_A! extend_(A|V) M, sending s tensor [m]_a to [s tensor m]_a, uniquely among isomorphisms satisfying this formula. No ordinary tensor comparison or tower coherence is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03CY, 03EK and 0E8I; extraction of the scalar, tensor transport and strict tower steps of lem-sf-cbc-slice-tensor-generator-coherence.

proof.text: Restricting scalars leaves the direct-sum extension presheaf and its restriction maps unchanged. Sheafification therefore gives k, the identity on original summands. Its uniqueness follows by the sheafification adjunction and direct-sum extensionality. Construct l by the scalar-extension adjunction and the slice-extension adjunction, whose composed right adjoints agree. Their adjunction units send m to [m] and to 1 tensor m, respectively. Thus l sends s tensor [m] to [s tensor m], by linearity over the coefficient ring. Apply the scalar-extension adjunction, then direct-sum extensionality, to show that this formula uniquely determines l. This construction includes only the scalar comparisons; it makes no assertion about ordinary tensors or towers.

proof_origin.place: Generator normalization and strict coherence refinement of Tags 03DI, 03CY, 03EK and 0E8I.

theorem scalarComparisons_exists :
    ∃ (k : ∀ A : Under R,
    scalars.{max c v, v, r} (R.over V) ((sliceAlgebras.{c, v, r} R V).obj A) ⋙
        localizedSystemExtension.{c, v, r} R V ≅
      localizedSystemExtension.{c, v, r} A.right V ⋙ scalars.{c, v, r} R A)
      (l : ∀ A : Under R, LinearComparison.{c, v, r} R V A),
      (∀ A,
    ScalarExtensionNormalized.{c, v, r} R V A (k A)) ∧
      (∀ A e,
    ScalarExtensionNormalized.{c, v, r} R V A e → e = k A) ∧
      (∀ A, LinearNormalized.{c, v, r} R V A (l A)) ∧
      (∀ A e, LinearNormalized.{c, v, r} R V A e → e = l A)
